title: He Gave America the Yo-Yo. Duncan Owned the Word.
aria: Animated short about Pedro Flores, who popularised the yo-yo in 1920s America, and the 1965 court ruling that said the company which bought his business could not own the word yo-yo
foot: Narration is an AI voice (Kokoro, af_heart). Music and effects: original score with CC0 samples (VSCO 2 Community Edition, Kenney). Events follow Duncan v. Royal Tops Mfg. Co., 343 F.2d 655 (7th Cir. 1965), the Smithsonian, the University of Houston and the International Directory of Company Histories; faces, rooms and staging are illustration. Not affiliated with Duncan, Flores or any toy brand.
